$schema: informal — DataDein design tokens, source: DataDein-Styleguide.pdf v1.0 (2025)

beton.role: Light neutral surface, secondary text on dark

staalgraa.role: Mid neutral, borders, muted UI elements

marine.role: Primary accent — links, active states, primary chart series

energi.role: Highlight accent — CTAs, key deltas, selected states. Use sparingly, not a rotation color.

usageNotes: Avoid pairing colors of similar mid-tone value; prefer clear light/dark contrast.
Energi is the only saturated color in the palette — reserve it for the single most important element in a view.
For multi-series charts, differentiate primarily by value (light vs dark) rather than hue, since the palette is intentionally low-saturation.

primary.usage: Large titles and key headings only. Not for body copy or long text blocks.

secondary.usage: Body copy, longer text passages. SemiBold (600) for secondary headings and emphasis.

correctUse: Sufficient contrast between logo and background
Use on dark, mid-grey, or light-grey solid backgrounds with the matching logo variant
incorrectUse: Placing on busy photo or textured backgrounds
Crowding — logo needs clear space from other elements
Placing directly beside another brand's logo

imagery.toneOfVoice: muted, professional grey/blue neutrals with occasional warm accent
imagery.notes: Blur is also used to anonymize people in the background of photos. Mood balances calm and activity.
